baseline.coordinate_convention: Source world: x forward, y lateral, z up; extrinsic xyz roll/pitch/yaw. No camera transform.

candidate.coordinate_convention: Source world: x forward, y lateral, z up; extrinsic xyz roll/pitch/yaw. No camera transform.

full_trace_sway_comparison.scope: Actual world amplitudes only. Reference tracking quality, camera and retiming cannot substitute for these two gates. Stability, foot progress/slip, caps and CAD checks remain separate.

metrics_scope: Full raw original actual samples only; no phase resampling, camera offset or clipped comparison timeline.

phase_map.semantics: Exact controller/reference phases; not measured contact-force event alignment.

baseline_s.handling: Only final display interval ends at saved actual time; internal exact controller boundaries unchanged; no physics extrapolation.

candidate_s.handling: Only final display interval ends at saved actual time; internal exact controller boundaries unchanged; no physics extrapolation.
